description: Main bearded caveman in yellow tunic with black spots; many redrawn poses (heart eyes small; slumped; squat prayer; shrug; thumbs up; sweating grin; cheering; painter; arms crossed; hands on hips; club charge; berries; kangaroo; kneeling; crying; kissing floor; ghost). Redrawn per pose, not reused identically.
Caveman slumped under bare tree with black rain cloud; appears at start and again at 128.68s, redrawn smaller/shifted second time.
Cavewoman long black hair; angry hands on hips; seated waving in stone chair; later neutral stare version with small-dot dress and hatched close-up. Redrawn per appearance.
Wild-haired girl: manic grin; worried with '1+1=1'; kneeling shouting at sun. Same character redrawn three ways.
Laughing boy riding a bored sabertooth cat.
First cave seller: bearded, yellow suit, black tie; poses scowl, grin-pointing, thinking, devil horns, laughing, dead. Redrawn per pose.
Second seller: bald mustached man in yellow suit; crawling from bush, huge face, whisper, handshake, laughing, sneaking away from cloud.
Bank officer in dark suit with mustache at desk line: smug clasped hands, finger to lips close-up, laughing pointing.
Large bald bearded man in black suit; smug clasped hands, palm out, arms crossed, thumbs up; also silhouette and flexed arm.
Caveman in brown spotted tunic: waving smiling, hand-shake partner, thinking. Likely the named family member (INFERRED).
Aged wrinkled caveman standing then lying dead; then handshake.
Skull-shaped cave drawing recurring as the cave motif; reused drawing at different scales (opening with heart-eyed man; alone; red X; for-sale sign; reprise with smug man).
Textured stone cave with black entrance and stone sign slab; blank then 'BANK'.
'CAVES FOR SALE' listing with cave icons and amenity lines.
Stone fireplace with orange-red flame; the only orange-red object besides devil horns and X.
Green mold pillow; reappears as head cushion for reclining man.
Stone shelf; rock drawn with grey hatching popped on top.
Yellow coins stamped with bearded head: three in hand with fly; pile of eight reused identically beside clock and desk.
Single large hatched moon then grid of many small copies (count gag).
White alarm clock; static then ringing/tilted versions.
Empty puffy white smoke cloud with small puffs; fades out.
Bow-tied gift box labelled 'THANK'.
Black ball and chain on crying man's ankle.
Stone slabs and stylus for signing.
Paintbrush and black paint bucket.
Stone tablet with handwritten 'CAVE Sweet CAVE'; reused identically large then scaled smaller.
Crude stick-figure drawing of four screaming people; deliberately childlike line.
Woolly mammoth, berry bush with basket, white kangaroo with box: the gathering/delivery props.
Thick red X pop-on over cave.
Bare tree, with translucent ghost caveman fading in at left in final hold.
Handwritten caps for words/numerals: 'MORTGAGE', 'BANK', 'x 1,000,000', 'x 2,000,000', '2', '1', '1+1=1', 'THANK'; lowercase 'interest'; heavy 'BOOM!'.
Pencil-hatched realistic close-ups (cavewoman face, caveman face, rock, moon, silhouette) contrasting with flat cartoon style.
Opacity fades used on text and cloud outline and ghost; no other transitions seen.
